after_snapshot.reference product: connector, battery control board, plated contacts
after_snapshot.source: Independent Molex-based connector engineering reference. Official product facts: two 705510038 headers at 1.023 g/4 contacts each, two 705550045 at 2.564 g/11 contacts each, and one 705550040 at 1.420 g/6 contacts: five headers, 36 contacts and 8.594 g. TI SLURB87 supplies the fitted counts. Molex identifies brass/phosphor-bronze contact options, high-temperature thermoplastic housing, minimum 0.381 micrometre gold and 1.905 micrometre tin plating, and 3.3 mm tails. The 0.64 mm finished contact width, 10 mm length, 8800 kg/m3 alloy density, 3 mm mating zone, 1.27 micrometre nickel, 50/50 brass/bronze, and 70/30 PA6/glass housing are engineering assumptions. Plating volumes use the retained thin-layer area approximation. Subtract plating VOLUME from the finished contact volume before multiplying the remainder by alloy density; the previous equal-mass subtraction was not volume-consistent with the finished-dimension interpretation. Close housing mass to the unchanged 8.594 g reference, normalise to 1 kg finished connector, and divide material purchases by the approved 95% retention. Retain 1 kWh/kg assembly and leave the 0.052631579 kg/kg manufacturing-reject fate unassigned. The 20 g module and 100 g central purchases are unchanged material allowances, not literal five-header counts. Samtec geometry and the old hazardous-incineration proposal are excluded. Sources: https://www.molex.com/en-us/products/part-detail/705510038 ; https://www.molex.com/en-us/products/part-detail/705550045 ; https://www.molex.com/en-us/products/part-detail/705550040 ; https://www.ti.com/lit/ug/slurb87/slurb87.pdf . This is a qualified engineering proxy, not a measured composition, validated plating process or complete fitted six-header census. Authenticated compiler/institutional licensing authority remains pending.

CLIC_snapshot.comment: Qualified connector material reference normalised from five Molex headers/36 contacts with an 8.594 g reference mass. Corrected plating-volume bookkeeping within the approved finished-contact geometry: subtract coating volume before converting remaining alloy volume to mass, then close the housing residual. This transfers approximately 0.004187% of reference mass from housing to alloy. Retain plating quantities, geometric/density/alloy/housing assumptions, 95% material retention and 1 kWh/kg assembly. Nominal rejects remain quantified with unassigned fate; no waste-treatment or recovery credit is added. Exact resin/alloy, plating chemistry, facilities and vehicle qualification remain unverified. Downstream 20 g/100 g allowances and source-version pairs are unchanged; no Samtec dimensions or full six-header claim are introduced.
